seoTitle: Remove Estimated Taxes in Shopify Checkout
metaDescription: Confused customers seeing "tax included" or estimated tax at checkout? Learn how to disable automatic tax calculation in Shopify and clean up the messaging.
intro: Some Shopify store owners find that customers see "tax included" or an estimated tax line at checkout and in POS even when taxes aren't supposed to be charged. This guide walks through disabling automatic tax calculations and adjusting the related settings so checkout reflects what you actually intend to charge.

steps.heading: Open your tax settings in Shopify Admin
steps.body: Go to the tax settings section of Shopify Admin, which controls how tax is calculated and displayed across your store and POS.

steps.heading: Disable automatic tax calculations
steps.body: Turn off automatic tax calculation for the regions or products where you don't want tax applied, rather than leaving Shopify's default settings active.

steps.heading: Adjust tax settings on individual products
steps.body: Check individual product pages for tax-related toggles, since some products may be set to charge tax independently of your general settings.

steps.heading: Edit checkout and POS wording
steps.body: Update the language shown at checkout and in POS so it no longer references "tax included" if that message doesn't match your actual pricing.

steps.heading: Confirm the change at checkout
steps.body: Run through a test checkout and a POS sale to verify the estimated tax and "tax included" message are both gone.

faq.question: Why does Shopify show "tax included" even if I don't charge tax?
faq.answer: This usually happens because automatic tax calculation is still enabled somewhere in your settings, even if you don't intend to collect tax.

faq.question: Does this affect POS as well as online checkout?
faq.answer: Yes, tax settings in Shopify apply across both online checkout and POS, so both need to be checked to fully remove the estimated tax.

faq.question: Will removing taxes affect my tax reporting?
faq.answer: It can, so it's worth confirming with your accountant or local tax requirements before turning off tax calculation entirely.

faq.question: Can I remove tax for specific products only?
faq.answer: Yes, individual product tax settings let you control this at a more granular level instead of changing it store-wide.
